newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Line tech firm Sparnex aims for NASDAQ or EASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: Line tech firm Sparnex aims for NASDAQ or EASDAQ.

text.p: Belgian telecommunications technology firm Sparnex aims to list on the U.S. NASDAQ or European EASDAQ growth stocks markets within the next two years.

A spokesman for Antwerp-based Sparnex said the company expected turnover of 120 million francs and a break-even result in 1997. It has capital of 120 million francs. Details on the listing plans were not available.

Sparnex specialises in high-bit-rate digital subscriber line (HDSL) technology, enabling multimedia companies to pipe a growing number of products down telephone lines, such as video on demand and tele-conferencing.
HDSL also helps telecoms companies face the competition from cable and mobile phone technology by allowing for higher capacity of existing copper wire networks.
